NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-8|payment]]s verifies the payment on-chain and fires a webhook automatically. The product delivers before the buyer closes their wallet. The only question is whether you have assembled the stack correctly.

content.text: The Honest Reality Most Creators Avoid

The truth is, platform restrictions aren't just a minor annoyance; they're a fundamental flaw in the architecture of digital commerce infrastructure. In countries like Cameroon, where financial systems are often fragile and subject to sudden changes, relying on platforms like Stripe can be catastrophic. When a platform restricts access or freezes accounts, creators lose their livelihoods, and their businesses suffer. It's a ticking time bomb, and I've seen it happen time and time again.
Why the Popular Advice Is Wrong

The popular advice to creators is to 'just use Stripe' or 'follow the crowds' and join the mainstream payment gateways. But this advice is based on a flawed assumption – that the infrastructure is robust and reliable. In reality, the infrastructure is fragile and prone to collapse. When the platforms fail, creators are left in the dark, struggling to find alternative solutions. It's not a matter of 'just using a different platform'; it's a matter of building a sovereign digital commerce stack that's immune to platform failures.
What the Architecture and Experience Actually Show

The architecture of digital commerce infrastructure is built on shaky ground. The reliance on centralized platforms creates a single point of failure, making it vulnerable to collapse. In the experience of African creators, this has played out time and time again. The experience shows that creators need a sovereign digital commerce stack – one that's built on decentralized infrastructure, free from platform dependencies. That's why I've shifted my focus to NOWPayments and Cloudflare infrastructure – it's the only way to ensure creators can sell their digital products without relying on platforms like Stripe.
Your digital commerce infrastructure should be built on decentralized infrastructure, not centralized platforms.
The Uncomfortable Truth About Platform Dependency

The uncomfortable truth is that most creators are still trapped in a cycle of platform dependency. They rely on platforms like Stripe for payment processing, and when the platforms fail, they're left scrambling to find alternative solutions. But the truth is, there's no need to be dependent on platforms. With NOWPayments and Cloudflare infrastructure, creators can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that's immune to platform failures. It's time to break free from the cycle of platform dependency and build a more resilient digital commerce infrastructure.
